messages:
🎉 Barcelona · Tue 17 Nov
Argentina play Costa Rica tonight, kick-off 00:00 Barcelona time; I could not confirm a bar showing it. Renfe strike today: Rodalies trains are reduced.

TODAY · Tue 17 Nov

1. Barça – Paris Basketball (EuroLeague)
🕘 Tonight 20:30 · 📍 Palau Blaugrana
📊 EuroLeague round 12 in a roughly 7,500-seat arena; 946 likes on @ordatwins' Barça basketball post
💶 Often from around €20 (per @ordatwins)
💬 The biggest crowd in town tonight: a EuroLeague home game, loud and easy to follow even if you rarely watch basketball. A city-guide tip this week. Go with friends, done by 22:30.
https://tickets-official.fcbarcelona.com/basketball-regular/select/2955877?hl=es-ES

2. Tapantoni — Sant Antoni tapas route
🕘 Today, bars' opening hours · 📍 36 bars around Sant Antoni
📊 36 bars taking part; 1,365 likes on @planesenbarcelona's round-up
💶 Tapa + drink €3.80 (on until 29 Nov)
💬 A bar crawl with a map: each bar serves one special tapa with a drink and you walk between them. A night for friends you already have, not for meeting people. I found nothing on how busy weeknights get.
https://www.tapantoni.com/es/index.html

3. Ed Maverick
🕘 Tonight 21:00 → 23:45 · 📍 Razzmatazz
📊 no public headcount (DICE doesn't publish one)
💶 €39.80
💬 Mexican singer-songwriter with a big young Latin following, in Razzmatazz's main room as part of the club's 26th-anniversary run. Tonight's largest concert; a sing-along crowd, not a dance night.
https://dice.fm/event/nvx5vq-ed-maverick-17th-nov-razzmatazz-barcelona-tickets

4. Moods at Noxe (26th floor W Barcelona)
🕘 Tonight 22:00 → 02:00 · 📍 Noxe Barcelona
📊 53 interested on RA · also on DICE, Eventbrite, Xceed
💶 Free guest list
💬 House music on the 26th floor of the W hotel with the city and sea below. Dressier, international crowd and free on the guest list, so it works as a late drink after the game or the tapas.
https://ra.co/events/2569424

5. Barcelona Entrepreneurs • Tuesday Meetup
🕘 Tonight 19:30 → 22:30 · 📍 ICON BCN
📊 26 going on Meetup (limit 100) · group has 9,191 members · also on Eventbrite
💶 Free
💬 The weekly founders and startup meetup: informal drinks with English-speaking people building things here. The one place tonight to meet new people in your own field.
https://www.meetup.com/barcelona-entrepreneurs-and-startups/events/316856557/

TOMORROW · Wed 18 Nov

1. BRESH CLUB
🕘 Wed 23:59 · 📍 Sala Apolo
📊 Listed on Sala Apolo's own agenda for Wed 18 Nov, main room
💬 The Argentine party brand you asked about, in Apolo's main room: reggaeton, pop and cumbia hits, and a crowd that is largely Argentine and Latin. Check ticket price and availability on the Apolo page.
https://www.sala-apolo.com/es/evento/bresh-club-20261118-7610

2. Electrostad: FREE PARTY with INOFF, Victor Hugo & friends
🕘 Wed 23:59 → 05:00 · 📍 Chica Club
📊 185 interested on RA · also on Eventbrite
💶 Free
💬 Free house and electronic night at Chica Club and the most-followed club listing of the day. Local, friendly crowd; a good second stop or an alternative to Bresh if you want electronic music.
https://ra.co/events/2554893

3. Artemas — LOVERCORE / Getting Up To No Good Tour
🕘 Wed 19:30 · 📍 Sala Apolo
📊 Listed on Sala Apolo's agenda, main room; listing sites give 20:30 for the show itself
💶 From about €36.50 (per La Ganzúa)
💬 The British alt-pop singer behind 'I Like the Way You Kiss Me', in Apolo's main room. Tomorrow's biggest concert, and Bresh starts in the same room at midnight.
https://www.sala-apolo.com/es/evento/artemas-20261118-7245

4. Afterwork AperiBarcelona: conoce gente nueva 🍹
🕘 Wed 18:30 → 22:30 · 📍 Sant Antoni
📊 98 guests on Luma
💶 Free
💬 Italian-community afterwork in Sant Antoni: aperitivo, drinks and a room of people who came specifically to meet others. Spanish and Italian will be the main languages. The social pick of the day.
https://luma.com/gyu8kuiw

5. Storytelling Barcelona – "Courage"
🕘 Wed 19:00 → 21:30 · 📍 El Noa Noa
📊 77 going on Meetup (limit 100) · group has 706 members · also on Eventbrite
💶 Free
💬 Monthly English-language storytelling night: people tell true stories on this month's theme, courage, to a full bar. A different kind of evening with an international crowd, over by 21:30.
https://www.meetup.com/storytelling-barcelona/events/317013620/

Scanned: Meetup 258 · RA 22 · DICE 12 · Xceed 12 · Eventbrite 94 (partial) · Luma 5 · Instagram 31 posts + 22 stories.
